description: This file defines functions and constants for rendering Slack interactive blocks, including buttons and select menus, using the Slack Web API types and openclaw plugin SDK.

methods.name: buildSlackReplyButtonActionId
methods.description: Constructs a unique action ID string for Slack reply buttons based on button and choice indices.

methods.name: buildSlackReplySelectActionId
methods.description: Constructs a unique action ID string for Slack reply select menus based on select index.

methods.name: resolveSlackButtonStyle
methods.description: Resolves the style of a Slack button, defaulting 'success' to 'primary'.

methods.name: buildSlackInteractiveBlocks
methods.description: Generates Slack Block Kit structures for interactive reply components based on provided interactive reply data.
